problem_type: Kind-classification boundary omits a registered executionKind, silently disabling a whole capability plane
symptom: Canvas model3d nodes can never dispatch generation: the generate button stays disabled and the runner throws 暂不支持 model3d, even with model, prompt and parameters fully set (PR #320 J11 probe, docs/qa/2026-09-02-journey-debt-product-gaps.md gap 2).
direct_cause: canRunGenerationNode enumerated image/text/audio/video and fell through to return false for model3d; resolveTaskKind additionally excluded model3d from the archetype transport bucket and had no model3d fallback, so even an opened gate would hit the bottom throw.
class_root: Per-kind branch chains are copied at every consumer of the kind classification with a closed-world default (return false / throw / wrong copy). The registry can declare a new executionKind without any structural signal forcing those chains to acknowledge it — the same class root as PR #286 (parameter bar missing for model3d).
affected_population: Canvas model3d nodes for every direct 3D vendor (RunningHub hunyuan3d / hitem3d / meshy6, meshy-7)
Spend confirmation copy for 3D runs (previously described as one image)
Composer reference controls and disabled-reason copy for image-to-3D
Text nodes wired into model3d nodes as prompt context
Any future kind added to the registry with a new executionKind
internal_only_reason: The defect is entirely in our renderer kind-classification chains; the vendor wire (RunningHub-style create-poll seed mappings for text_to_3d/image_to_3d) already existed and is exercised unchanged by the J11 fixture.
invariants: Every kind the registry declares with an executionKind is dispatchable by canRunGenerationNode for a bare no-archetype node; kinds without executionKind are never dispatchable.
resolveTaskKind resolves a TaskKind for every registered executionKind and never reaches the bottom throw for them; model3d honors the archetype mode transportTaskKind (text_to_3d / image_to_3d).
video and model3d share one archetype-slot-declared runnability branch (no parallel copy).
isTextPromptEdge and collectConnectedTextPromptParts agree on which execution kinds accept text prompt-context edges.
generality_proof: The fix widens the two shared boundaries (canRunGenerationNode tail branch now serves video+model3d from one slot-declared implementation; resolveTaskKind archetype bucket keyed on executionKind membership) instead of adding a 3D-only path, and the class regression matrices iterate GENERATION_NODE_KINDS and MODEL_ARCHETYPES, so any future kind or 3D archetype is asserted automatically without editing the tests.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Single dispatch gate: decide runnability for every registered executionKind from the archetype slot declarations; composer button and runner throat consume the same verdict.
Map every registered executionKind to a transport TaskKind, honoring archetype mode transportTaskKind before heuristics.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: video/model3d now share the slot-declared branch; registry exhaustive matrix in canRunGenerationNode.test.ts goes red for any unclaimed executionKind (red-checked: reverting the branch fails 10 tests).
model3d joined the archetype transport bucket plus a text_to_3d/image_to_3d fallback; resolveTaskKind matrix in catalogTaskActions.test.ts red-checked (2 failures when reverted).
model3d passes through to its own GenerationCostKind with honest unit copy (zh/en) instead of collapsing into image.

isModel3dLikeGenerationNodeKind joined the union and model3d gets model3dReferenceRequired copy instead of unsupportedKind; predicate coverage matrix in generationNodeKinds.test.ts asserts every executionKind is claimed.
model3d added on both the classification side and the consumption side (collectConnectedTextPromptParts + executor withConnectedTextPrompts) in the same change.
Already open-world: includes any node with a defined executionKind, so model3d was never excluded here (line 78).
Timeline clips are image/video/audio by design; GLB artifacts render in the node card viewer and are not timeline material.
Storyboard shots are an image/video domain by definition; 3D assets are not shot material.

recurrence.reason: Second same-class outbreak: PR #286 fixed the same omission in NodeParameterControls/resolveCatalogKind, and the dispatch chain still regressed because nothing structural forced kind chains to acknowledge new executionKinds.
same_class_scan: Grepped every consumer of getGenerationNodeExecutionKind / is*LikeGenerationNodeKind across src (17 files) and dispositioned each: 5 fixed (generationRunController, catalogTaskResolve, NodeGenerationComposer, connectedTextPrompt+referenceEdgeCapability pair, spendCostKind), rest confirmed open-world or by-design image/video domains (canvasProductionScope:78, useCanvasProductionActions, buildClipFromGenerationNode:48, SelectionPromptSaveController:52, storyboardTimelinePlan:55, gatherShotVerifyInputs:41, referenceAssetKindForNode:36, parameterReferenceSlots:116, BaseGenerationNode:253).

Checked executor and archetypes: generationNodeExecutor already had the model3d branch (#286) and all four model3d archetypes declare text_to_3d/image_to_3d transportTaskKinds, confirming the gate and bucket were the only dispatch blockers.
Red-verified both matrices catch the original defect: reverting the canRunGenerationNode branch fails 10 tests, reverting the resolveTaskKind bucket fails 2.

prevention.invariant: canRunGenerationNode claims every registry-declared executionKind (bare no-archetype nodes runnable, no-executionKind kinds never runnable), with video and model3d served by one shared slot-declared branch.
prevention.failure_mode: Adding a kind with a new executionKind without extending the gate makes the registry exhaustive matrix in canRunGenerationNode.test.ts and the predicate coverage matrix in generationNodeKinds.test.ts fail immediately; resolveTaskKind omissions fail the taskKind matrix in catalogTaskActions.test.ts.
prevention.strategy: Keep one slot-declared runnability implementation shared across kinds and pin the closed-world fallthroughs with registry-driven exhaustive matrices so the next executionKind cannot ship half-wired.

legacy_paths.rationale: No parallel implementation existed or was added; the missing branches joined the existing shared implementations (video slot branch, archetype transport bucket) instead of forking 3D-only paths.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Pure renderer classification-boundary fix; no dependency is introduced or upgraded.

migration: No data or schema migration: existing model3d nodes become dispatchable as-is, and previously impossible runs mean no stored artifacts depend on the old behavior.
residual_risks: Non-archetype custom 3D vendors rely on the image_to_3d/text_to_3d reference heuristic fallback (same tier as image/video heuristics) until they declare archetypes.
The J11 acceptance exercises the RunningHub-style seeded wire; other direct 3D vendors reuse the same catalog mapping path but were not individually wired in this change.
